utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don't suppose you've heard if they're sticking with the community center again, have you?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, we're set for the community center again! It's got plenty of space for all the workstations.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, good. I'll double-check my map to make sure there aren't any last-minute changes to the parking situation.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Quinn! I've been hearing bits about the repair drive—what's the scoop on what they're collecting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: They're collecting all sorts of tools and supplies—anything from hammers to paintbrushes. We're planning to fix up the playground and a few other spots around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I've got some old flower pots I've been meaning to fix up—would those be useful for the playground?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a toolbox with screwdrivers, pliers, and some spare screws—should I bring those for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, those would be useful. I've got a couple of things that need tightening.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I'll make sure to bring them along. Need me to look at anything else you've got?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive! Thanks, Cleo. So we're fixing up old things to keep 'em out of the trash? That's a good idea.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that's the idea! We're starting with the playground equipment in the park—that broken swing especially. Do you know of any other items around the neighborhood that need fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, let me think... I remember seeing a wobbly bench near the community garden. Maybe that could use some love too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, the old playground benches. The kids are so excited to help paint them. I just need to make sure it doesn't conflict with the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the benches! Right, I forgot about those. When did we decide to paint them?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Last week at the PTA meeting, remember? We thought Saturday morning would work best for everyone, but I need to double-check the pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks for offering, Ira—let's start with Sam's place; he's got some wrenches and a drill ready for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help pick up some of the smaller parts, if that's alright.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That'd be great, Uli—every bit helps. Maybe you could grab the screws and brackets from the hardware store while Ira and I handle the bigger pickups.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I'm just heading out to grab some tool donations for the repair drive — heard you might know a few folks who want to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I might, but first—is the drive still set for next Saturday? I need to be sure before I commit anyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, still next Saturday! I've got my truck free today if you want me to swing by and pick up anything right now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I need to double-check the drop-off hours before I haul that mower over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive is this weekend! We're meeting at my place at 10, then heading over to fix Mrs. Chen's fence—don't forget your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, I thought the drive was for collecting donations, not fixing fences. Are you sure about the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got a full socket set, screwdrivers, wrenches, and a drill with bits—should cover most basic fixes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's perfect! I bet they'll be thrilled to have you. Are you thinking of volunteering at the drive itself?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'd be happy to help out in person too—just let me know when and where.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I did check—he says he'll pick up the wood tomorrow morning, but that means we can't start until the afternoon at the earliest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So he's making us wait around for him? And what if he shows up with the wrong size boards again?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's exactly what I'm worried about. Maybe we should ask him to send a photo of the wood before he leaves the store.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, 10 at Vik's. I'll bring my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, thanks Dane. See you at 10.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, I'll be there. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll see you there whenever you can make it; even a little help goes a long way!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'll try to swing by for a bit before my errands. Noon works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Noon sounds perfect. I'll be there, so just look for me at the repair station.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I appreciate that, Ira. I'm thinking Saturday morning around 9 would be best for me to drop off that lawnmower—does that fit with the schedule you've heard?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I'm late to this—just got word from Vik that we're meeting at his place at 10 to fix Mrs. Chen's fence, so that lawnmower drop-off at 9 should work out fine.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that's settled then. I'll be at the drop-off at 9 sharp.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Bo, just double-checking — the repair drive is at the community center on Oak Street this weekend, right? I need to plan around school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I thought Opal said it's the second Saturday of next month, not this weekend. Are you sure?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh shoot, you might be right. Let me double-check my calendar — I think I mixed up the dates.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, Sam's lending tools. We'll wrap up by noon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, that gives us plenty of time to sort everything before the afternoon crowd shows up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Let's get started.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Rosa, I've got some tools set aside for the repair drive. Want to sort through them with me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's wonderful, Sam! I'd love to sort through them with you—let's head over now and see what we've got to work with.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, let's head to my shed—I've got them all organized by type.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Uli, I've heard about the repair drive—can you walk me through exactly what we're planning to fix?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Well, Hana, mostly small household items and garden tools that people have set aside. I'm hoping we can get a few old lawnmowers running again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so it's more about appliances and tools than playground stuff. Do you have a list of items people have already dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, anything really—broken chairs, leaky faucets, you name it! People are bringing all sorts of stuff.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, I can bring my spare screws and nails—might come in handy for those chairs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's perfect, Cleo! I'll add you to the list—Tess is already in to help with the playground gear, so we're getting a good crew together.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Pia, how many volunteers have you rounded up so far for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Only about five so far, and that's not nearly enough to cover all the tasks we planned.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Five? That's tight. What's the biggest task we're looking at—maybe we can trim the list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Kira, I heard you might be helping with that repair drive too. Let me know if you need me to grab any tools or supplies while I'm out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually going to help that guy with his broken fence? I thought he was bluffing about fixing it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: What? No, I'm talking about the community center repair drive, not a fence. Are you thinking of something else?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: So Jules, did you hear about the repair drive? They're fixing up old bikes, appliances, and even furniture—everyone's bringing stuff from all over!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I heard about it! I'm planning to bring my soldering iron and teach a few basic fixes. Want to team up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That sounds perfect! I'm meeting Dane at 10 at my place—we're heading to fix Mrs. Chen's fence first. Want to join us after?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! That's the thing where we fix up old stuff, isn't it? I think I have a broken toaster somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, exactly! You should bring that toaster—they're accepting all kinds of broken things. I'm planning to help fix the playground equipment. Want to come with me on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday? That sounds good, I think. But remind me what time we're supposed to meet—I keep forgetting these things.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Rey! Are you planning to come by the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I was just hearing about it from Uli. Sounds like a good way to put things back together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely! It's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. Hope to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The community center on Oak Street, starting at 10 AM — I've got that written down now, so no one gets confused like last time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal! I'll make sure to be there at 10.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, I'll keep an eye out for any stragglers who might end up at the old firehouse by mistake.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
